# sonrai_entitlements (Data Source)

AWS entitlements available at a scope: Identity Center permission sets, account access roles and SAML roles.

`sonrai_jit_configuration` enrols entitlements by name, and a name that matches nothing enrols nothing without reporting an error. Read them here rather than copying them out of the console.

`user_count` is how many identities reach the scope through the entitlement today, which is usually what decides whether enrolling it is disruptive. It is null where no count applies, as it does not for a SAML role assigned in the identity provider; read `user_count_display` to render it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Everything federated users reach this account through.
data "sonrai_entitlements" "account" {
  scope = "aws/r-abcd/123456789012"
}

# Only the account access roles.
data "sonrai_entitlements" "roles" {
  scope = "aws/r-abcd/123456789012"
  type  = "AWS_ACCOUNT_ACCESS_ROLE"
}

# Enrol everything that is not the broadest permission set, which would
# otherwise put administrators behind a JIT session.
resource "sonrai_jit_configuration" "account" {
  scope      = "aws/r-abcd/123456789012"
  deny_first = true

  enrolled_entitlements = [
    for e in data.sonrai_entitlements.account.entitlements : {
      name = e.name
      type = e.type
    } if e.name != "AdministratorAccess"
  ]
}

output "entitlement_usage" {
  value = {
    for e in data.sonrai_entitlements.account.entitlements : e.name => e.user_count
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `scope` (String) Scope to read entitlements at, for example `aws/r-abcd/123456789012`.

### Optional

- `type` (String) Return only entitlements of this type: `AWS_PERMISSION_SET`, `AWS_ACCOUNT_ACCESS_ROLE` or `AWS_SAML_ROLE`. Omit for all three. An identity that qualifies as more than one type appears only under the more specific one, account access role ahead of SAML role, so the filtered lists never overlap.

### Read-Only

- `entitlements` (Attributes List) Each entitlement with its type and current usage, by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entitlements))
- `id` (String) The scope these entitlements were read at.
- `names` (Set of String) Just the names, for passing to `enrolled_entitlements`.

<a id="nestedatt--entitlements"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entitlements`

Read-Only:

- `labels` (Set of String)
- `name` (String)
- `type` (String)
- `user_count` (Number) Identities with access through this entitlement. Null where no count applies, which is not the same as zero.
- `user_count_display` (String) `user_count` rendered for display, or `N/A` where no count applies.
